The scoped native useUnits() reads web-parity useSettings(): unitPrefs.distance from unit_of_length ('mi'->'mi' else 'km', mirroring web deriveDistance), unitPrefs.energy fixed to the 'kWh' DEFAULT_ENERGY_PREF, plus locale (deriveLocale) + precision (derivePrecision) threaded into formatEnergy.

formatEnergy parity (web @/hooks/useUnits -> @/lib/unitConversion formatEnergy): null/undefined/NaN -> DEFAULT_EMPTY_DISPLAY '\u2014'; digits = resolvePrecision(pref.precision, options.precision, DEFAULT_PRECISION.energy=2) (override>=0 floored, else pref, else 2); value = convertEnergyFromSI(wh,'kWh') = wh/1000; result = `${fmtNumber(kwh, digits, locale)} kWh`. All four call sites pass { precision: 1 } so digits resolves to 1 in every case (Total Used, Total Charged, Net Energy charged-used), matching the web 1dp kWh output exactly.

As in the web source the energy series is the raw energy_wh value (YAxis shows Wh) while the dropped hover Tooltip suffixed 'kWh'; that exact quirk is preserved and the Tooltip formatter `${fmtNumber(value,2)} kWh` survives as the chart accessibilityLabel summary. chartGrid/chartMargin/chartAnimation/ResponsiveContainer are Recharts-only layout and have no native analogue.

AnimatedNumber (native-safe port of data-display/AnimatedNumber.tsx, web L8 + L119-122): same value/duration(1)/decimals(0)/prefix/suffix props; same ease-out-quad count-up from 0 driven by requestAnimationFrame (Date.now in place of performance.now — RN has no guaranteed performance.now; precedent: web-parity FleetStatsBar), frame cancelled on unmount; tabular-nums -> fontVariant ['tabular-nums']; fmtNumber(display, decimals).

WidgetShell + DataFreshness + EmptyState (web ./WidgetShell + @/components/data-display + @/components/feedback): native-safe reductions matching the sibling CostForecastWidget/DriveScoreWidget ports — loading -> skeleton View, error -> danger AppText body, 1500ms pulse-on-update glow (shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,197,94,0.15)] -> shellPulse), inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph + relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less, web L91), title row with icon+uppercase muted title.

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/span/h3 -> View/AppText; CSS vars text-[var(--text-primary|muted)] -> colors.textPrimary/textMuted; text-2xl/text-[10px]/text-[11px] -> explicit fontSize; the StatCard look (Card + label/icon header, value 2xl bold + unit, optional trend row) reproduced in WidgetStatGrid with surfaceRaised cells and flex-basis from the web container-query cols (2->47% / 3->31%). No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported. Imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View + DimensionValue/StyleProp/TextStyle types), the already-ported web-parity useEnergyStats/useVehicles/useSettings, the native AppText, and the theme tokens (colors/spacing). StyleSheet keys + properties are alphabetically sorted for react-native/sort-styles. State names (data/isLoading/error/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch/justUpdated/display), the API path (/vehicles/{id}/energy?days=30 via useEnergyStats), unit handling (distance pref + formatEnergy kWh via useUnits/useSettings), and i18n keys/intent are all preserved.
